name: Scenula
author: goldbarth
description: Rotating wallpaper collages from ArtStation artists, fitted to your screen. Themes from local image tagging, palette presets for every Omarchy theme, and controls to pause, go back, replace a single image or hide one. ArtStation is the only image source for now; open an issue on GitHub to request another site.

barWidget.description: Rotating ArtStation collages. Click for settings, middle-click for the next one.
